question: Can we reduce LoRA adaptation runtime while preserving command-conditioned geometry, appearance and future planning gradients?

recommendations.candidate: LPWM SDPA preserving all 21 masks and dropout probabilities
recommendations.evidence: FP32 output/VJP agreement and exploratory 5.6–9.6% one-camera duration reduction
recommendations.next_gate: Actual official-loss DDP batch16/effective64 comparison, memory below48decimalGB, preserved model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG, separate execution registration

recommendations.candidate: Compile repeated LPWM transformer and LoRA operations

recommendations.next_gate: Profile graph breaks, dynamic time lengths, FiLM hooks, compilation cost and steady-state throughput

recommendations.candidate: Larger GPU microbatch while retaining effective64
recommendations.evidence: Current16x2accumx2GPU and40.325GB/card; no new batch24/32 memory/speed measurement

not_recommended_as_execution_optimizatio: Caching trainable LPWM outputs across updates

validation_scope: Single scene, one camera, eight-step differentiable rollout, random particle VJP, not official loss, not PDMS; shared GPU timings are exploratory.
